description: This Java source file contains utility methods for handling Android Gradle projects within the IntelliJ IDEA JPS build system, including retrieving modules, facets, SDKs, and creating compiler messages.

classes.name: AndroidGradleJps
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for managing Android Gradle modules, facets, SDKs, and compiler messages within the JPS build system.

methods.name: getFirstExtension
methods.description: Returns the first Android-Gradle facet extension in a given ModuleChunk.

methods.name: hasAndroidGradleFacet
methods.description: Checks if any module in the project has the Android-Gradle facet.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves the Android-Gradle facet extension from a module.

methods.name: getOrCreateGradleSystemExtension
methods.description: Gets or creates the Gradle system extension for a module.

methods.name: getGradleSystemExtension
methods.description: Retrieves the Gradle system extension from a module.

methods.name: getFirstAndroidSdk
methods.description: Returns the first Android SDK found in a ModuleChunk.

methods.name: createCompilerMessage
methods.description: Creates a compiler message with specified kind and text.

methods.name: createCompilerMessage
methods.description: Creates a compiler message from a GradleMessage object.
